ontology.note: Existing ontology alignment; full configuration and port shape contracts remain to be defined.

changes.description: Renamed from `area` to `study_area`. The old identifier keeps resolving: a saved workflow naming `area` is rewritten on open and stamped with sourceMigration, because the operation is unchanged and a rename must not refuse work the way a retirement does. `area` is a category noun -- which area? It is the study area, and the widget's own title has said "Study area" all along, so the type and the title disagreed. The port type and the port name stay `area`: a port carrying a study area is still an area, and a rename changes a node type, never a port. No contract change: ports, output, parameters and behaviour are identical.
Add dimensioned square and rectangular bounding boxes; persisted CRS84 geometry and existing polygons are unchanged.

evidence.note: Repository regression coverage exists; this release entry does not certify a widget independently.
